==Description==
The '''Frost Tank''' was an ice version of the original version of the [[Tank]]. It only appeared in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]].

It had the same speed as the [[Tank]], but had lower health. Like the [[Tank]], it could throw boulders at towers with the ''Rock Throw'' ability to stun them.

==Appearance==
The '''Frost Tank''' had a similar appearance to the original version of the [[Tank]], being mostly a recolor of the tank that looked more frosty and icy. It was a buffed up enemy with light blue glowing eyes and a drooling zombie face. It had muscular arms and light blue skin. It wore blue granite shorts, walked with a hunchback and had its head slightly tilted. It had blue horns sticking out of the sides of its head. There were also ice crystals on its back and on its shoulders.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, such as the [[Archer|Holiday Archer]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Ranger|Outlaw]] are effective choices to defeat this enemy, though it may take a while due to the '''Frost Tank's''' high health.
*Using the [[Commander]] can help significantly, especially with its ''Call of Arms'' ability.
*The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]] can slow the '''Frost Tank''' down, making them great support choices against it.
*You can place other towers away from the main group of towers to distract the '''Frost Tank'''.
**You can also spread out your towers to mitigate the effects of its ''Rock Throw'' ability.
**Alternatively, you can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse the stun, as long the [[Medic]] is not already stunned from the attack.
